config.note_dataset: High-Gamma Dataset (Schirrmeister2017): EXECUTED movements, 14 subjects, official training runs (~880 trials) and test runs (~160 trials).
config.model_fixed: braindecode Deep4Net defaults, final_conv_length=auto; time pooling 3 (2 for the 400-sample windows), drop_prob from the profile
config.scheduler: per profile: plateau = ReduceLROnPlateau on VALIDATION loss; cosine; none. Refit replays the plateau learning rates of the first fit
config.checkpoint_rule: lowest validation loss, early stopping with patience; refit keeps final weights
config.folds: train on the official HGD training runs (last 25% = validation, chronological), refit on all training runs, test once on the official test runs

attribution.target: pre-softmax logit of the true class

faithfulness.removal: channel set to 0 (its standardised mean) on the TEST block; evaluation only, never used for any choice
faithfulness.ranking: mean of the four attribution maps from the VALIDATION block

config.randomisation_check: Spearman between trained-model and untrained-model saliency
